status: fixed before quarterly fitting; this is an analysis specification record, not an original preregistration
support_rule_revision: The first saved attempt exposed a singleton full-calendar-quarter FE in the candidate support; the fixed implementation now iterates city/quarter all-zero and singleton removal to stability before the repaired fit.
source_panel: not included; saved quarterly sample is data/results/reference/quarterly/quarterly_dynamic_sample_v18.csv

candidate_rule.current: finite Q >= 0, finite E > 0, finite W > 0
candidate_rule.lag_link: exact city_key and quarter_period_ordinal - lag = 1,2,3; no post-drop shift
candidate_rule.lag_outcomes: Q at lag quarters need not be observed or positive

main_support_rule.all_zero_fe: remove candidate cities whose candidate Q sum is zero
main_support_rule.singleton: after the candidate city all-zero rule, iteratively remove every city or full-calendar-quarter FE group with one row; the same rule is reapplied until stable
main_support_rule.separation: run an LP existence diagnostic and iteratively remove city/quarter FE groups that are all-zero or singleton; no coefficient truncation
main_support_rule.common_support: D0, D1, and D3 use one final estimable support and one FE structure

models.fixed_effects: city FE + full calendar quarter FE (2019Q1 differs from 2019Q2; not four seasonal dummies)
models.offset: ln W; W is exposure, not a frequency weight
models.weather: no quarterly weather control; quarterly weather fields are unavailable

inference.estimator: Poisson QMLE via statsmodels GLM IRLS

covid.support: D3 main final support, year <= 2022, current genuine source-date covid_mean finite and coverage complete
covid.models: D3-C0 without covid_mean; D3-C1 with covid_mean/10

path: c_h is the model-implied conditional weekly-activity elasticity at h quarters after a persistent proportional facility-level change; not cumulative activity and not a causal impulse response

software.engine: statsmodels.GLM Poisson IRLS; manual score/Hessian sandwich
